serverInfo.name: Scientific Figure Library
serverInfo.title: Scientific Figure Library
serverInfo.description: Browse reviewed scientific-figure templates, inspect exact previews, and hand an explicit selection back to the Agent.

result.instructions: Start with figure_library_get_skill for the single SFL Skill and available guidance. Use ordinary search, thumbnail resources/image tools and pagination for host-native browsing; the MCP App is optional. Exact preview confirmation is required before materialization planning.

tools.name: figure_library_get_skill
tools.title: Read the core SFL Skill or one bundled reference
tools.description: Start here for SFL guidance and host capabilities. Returns the same bundled SKILL.md without requiring Library setup. Use only listed document IDs for on-demand references; does not install a Skill or execute helper code.

tools.name: figure_library_get_candidate_images
tools.title: Read candidate thumbnails for host display
tools.description: Get up to 12 current-result thumbnails as standard MCP images with exact candidate labels. Display a page for user selection; do not iterate the entire result set. Does not confirm exact previews or create materialization receipts.

tools.name: figure_library_open
tools.title: Open Scientific Figure Library
tools.description: Open the read-only candidate workbench. New installs return setup_required until the global Library and Local workspace are bound; otherwise ask for an uploaded reference, data profile, or plotting goal before searching.

tools.name: figure_library_search
tools.title: Search all matching scientific figure Providers
tools.description: Search Local Published, FigureYa, Open Figure Modules and opted-in personal Providers. Present candidates using host thumbnail resources/image tools or the optional App, then wait for selection. Community is explicit-only; Working, Capture and flat-v1 entries are excluded.

resultSetId.description: Present the exact cached result set returned by an Open Figure PR Plan; keep its query, filters, providers and limit unchanged.

tools.name: figure_library_search_page
tools.title: Load another candidate page
tools.description: Paginate an existing search result set for the host Agent or App. Keep the resultSetId and opaque cursor unchanged.

tools.name: figure_library_describe
tools.title: Describe one provider-qualified exact template
tools.description: Describe an exact Local Published release, bundled/personal public template, or commit-pinned FigureYa module. A bare templateId is deliberately insufficient.

tools.name: figure_library_preview
tools.title: Preview one provider-qualified exact template
tools.description: Return one selected preview as standard MCP image content and optionally copy it to a trusted absolute directory. This compatibility tool does not authorize materialization.

tools.name: figure_library_preview_exact
tools.title: Load one exact preview for confirmation
tools.description: App-only exact preview. It returns image bytes only to the component and issues a session-bound confirmation challenge.

tools.name: figure_library_preview_exact_headless
tools.title: Load one exact preview for explicit headless review
tools.description: Model-visible exact preview. Call only after the user selects a candidate, explicitly delegates visual review, or an App updateModelContext handoff selects one candidate; do not iterate all results.

tools.name: figure_library_create_plot_task_headless
tools.title: Create a plotting task from explicit headless selections
tools.description: Create the same v2 plotting-task handoff used by the App after the user selects candidates in an agent-only session. Selections must belong to the current cached result set. This read-only tool does not preview, materialize, execute code, or install dependencies.

tools.name: figure_library_confirm_selection
tools.title: Confirm a visibly loaded exact preview
tools.description: App-only confirmation. The candidate workbench calls this only after the exact image load event and an explicit user click.

tools.name: figure_library_confirm_selection_headless
tools.title: Confirm an exact preview after headless Agent review
tools.description: Model-visible confirmation after figure_library_preview_exact_headless. Use only after a user selection, explicit delegation, or an App updateModelContext handoff when serverTools is unavailable; this call cannot prove UI visibility.

tools.name: figure_library_record_ui_event
tools.title: Record a bounded candidate-workbench event
tools.description: Internal App-only structured diagnostics. It accepts a fixed event enum and no arbitrary log text.

tools.name: figure_library_export_diagnostics
tools.title: Export Scientific Figure Library diagnostics
tools.description: Export a bounded, secret-safe diagnostic ZIP for the current server session. Defaults to sanitized_bundle, excludes user text and absolute paths, and never uploads data.

tools.name: figure_library_source_status
tools.title: Inspect global Library and Provider status
tools.description: Return complete text and structured status for the global portable Library, immutable lifecycle, write lock, and every registered Local, Community, FigureYa, or personal Provider. Community is reported as frozen and excluded from default search. Capture/project-pin status is intentionally absent. New installs report setup_required until both the global Library and Local workspace are bound.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_bind_global
tools.title: Plan global ScientificFigureLibrary binding
tools.description: Validate the user-selected global Library directory and optionally stage a non-destructive flat-v1 copy. This read-only plan never chooses a project directory implicitly.

libraryDirectory.description: Absolute native path chosen by the user for the one global portable Library.

legacySourceDirectory.description: Optional unmarked flat-v1 source copied non-destructively into migration staging.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_bind_global
tools.title: Apply confirmed global Library binding
tools.description: Apply the exact reviewed binding plan using operation-id idempotency and stale-plan checks.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_bind_workspace
tools.title: Plan Local workspace binding
tools.description: Validate the user-selected Local workspace directory. First-time machine confirmation only; later starts reuse the saved locator. Never infers the current project folder.

workspaceDirectory.description: Absolute native path for the machine-local draft knowledge base (inbox/drafts/gallery).

tools.name: figure_library_apply_bind_workspace
tools.title: Apply confirmed Local workspace binding
tools.description: Apply the exact reviewed workspace binding plan. After this first confirmation, later MCP starts reuse the same directory across projects.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_recover_write_lock
tools.title: Plan abandoned global write-lock recovery
tools.description: Inspect one exact Library write lock. The user must stop every Wisp, Codex, Claude, and other writer before approving recovery; locks are never auto-stolen.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_recover_write_lock
tools.title: Apply confirmed global write-lock recovery
tools.description: Archive the exact unchanged abandoned lock and write a recovery receipt after all writers are confirmed stopped.

tools.name: figure_library_review_open
tools.title: Inspect template review state
tools.description: Host-neutral read-only inspection of Working, Published, history, Diff, and Review findings.

tools.name: figure_library_preview_working_revision
tools.title: Preview an exact active Working selector
tools.description: Return the canonical image for an exact active pending Working plan or current Working Head. This read-only tool does not create a preview receipt or authorize materialization.

tools.name: figure_library_template_history
tools.title: Inspect immutable template history
tools.description: Return immutable Content Revision and Release history.

tools.name: figure_library_diff_revisions
tools.title: Diff two immutable Content Revisions
tools.description: Compare complete revision fields and asset inventories without modifying either revision.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_working_revision
tools.title: Plan a direct-intake Working Revision
tools.description: Validate user-confirmed image/code intake and return an immutable Working Revision plan. The operations never calls a model or executes code.

application.description: FigureYa-style biological use cases as Markdown; required for new or updated Working revisions. Not visual encodings.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_working_revision
tools.title: Apply a confirmed Working Revision plan
tools.description: Reverify source bytes and apply the exact cached plan with operation-id idempotency and stale-state checks.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_review_gate_update
tools.title: Plan Review Gate decisions
tools.description: Create a read-only lifecycle plan. No files or pointers are changed.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_review_gate_update
tools.title: Apply Review Gate decisions
tools.description: Apply the exact cached plan with operation-id idempotency and stale-state checks.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_publish_working_revision
tools.title: Plan atomic approval and publication
tools.description: Create a read-only lifecycle plan. No files or pointers are changed.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_publish_working_revision
tools.title: Apply atomic approval and publication
tools.description: Apply the exact cached plan with operation-id idempotency and stale-state checks.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_discard_working_revision
tools.title: Plan Working Head discard
tools.description: Create a read-only lifecycle plan. No files or pointers are changed.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_discard_working_revision
tools.title: Apply Working Head discard
tools.description: Apply the exact cached plan with operation-id idempotency and stale-state checks.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_restore_release
tools.title: Plan historical Release restoration as Working
tools.description: Create a read-only lifecycle plan. No files or pointers are changed.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_restore_release
tools.title: Apply historical Release restoration as Working
tools.description: Apply the exact cached plan with operation-id idempotency and stale-state checks.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_adopt_versioning
tools.title: Plan explicit flat-v1 adoption
tools.description: Create a read-only lifecycle plan. No files or pointers are changed.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_adopt_versioning
tools.title: Apply explicit flat-v1 adoption
tools.description: Apply the exact cached plan with operation-id idempotency and stale-state checks.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_materialize
tools.title: Plan exact template materialization
tools.description: Require a one-time confirmed exact preview receipt, then resolve the provider-qualified selector and check the destination without writing files.

exactSelector.description: Provider-qualified exact selector returned by figure_library_search.

previewReceipt.description: Required one-time receipt returned by figure_library_confirm_selection or figure_library_confirm_selection_headless.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_materialize
tools.title: Apply confirmed exact materialization
tools.description: Apply the cached exact plan once. All failures are terminal and must not be retried with another mode, provider, downloader, or substitute template.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_bundle_export
tools.title: Plan a portable Library or Published-template bundle
tools.description: Inventory either the authoritative Library (excluding rebuildable indexes/runtime locks) or one exact reachable Published Release. Produces a directory-bundle plan and writes nothing.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_bundle_export
tools.title: Apply a confirmed portable bundle export
tools.description: Reverify the exact source inventory and visible expectedTarget, write a new directory bundle without overwrite, and persist an idempotent export receipt. A durable pre-write intent can recover a completed target after operations restart.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_full_restore
tools.title: Plan full-Library Restore or Fork
tools.description: Verify a full backup directory. Restore preserves libraryId and requires explicit authority transfer; Fork creates a new libraryId with fork provenance.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_full_restore
tools.title: Apply confirmed full-Library Restore or Fork
tools.description: Restore/fork into an absent target, verify every byte, and write an immutable operation receipt. It never changes the active locator automatically.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_template_bundle_import
tools.title: Plan Published-template bundle import as Working
tools.description: Verify an exact Published-template bundle, copy its immutable assets into a new local candidate, and plan a Working Revision. Source approval is provenance only and is never inherited.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_template_bundle_import
tools.title: Apply confirmed template-bundle import as Working
tools.description: Reverify the exact bundle and apply only the planned Working Revision. Local review and publish remain mandatory.

tools.name: figure_library_github_auth_status
tools.title: Inspect GitHub CLI publication authentication
tools.description: Read-only check of the official gh login and central repository permissions. SFL never reads or prints the token.

tools.name: figure_library_github_auth_instructions
tools.title: Show official GitHub CLI authentication instructions
tools.description: Return a terminal command for the user to run. This tool never launches a browser or login process.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_publication_pr
tools.title: Plan a staged central publication pull request
tools.description: Read-only Archive or Catalog PR Plan. Archive uses one sanitized submission; Catalog requires a manually merged Archive PR and re-verifies its fixed merge commit and ZIP.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_publication_pr
tools.title: Apply a reviewed staged central publication pull request
tools.description: Re-check the gh account, permissions, source, merge gate, base, and file identities; then create a branch/commit/PR through Git Data API. Never merges the PR.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_open_figure_module_pr
tools.title: Plan an Open Figure Modules pull request
tools.description: Sanitize one exact Local Published Release into an Open Figure module, search FigureYa and Open Figure Modules for similar figures, and show a GitHub PR Plan without writing or merging. Path collisions fail closed. Similar hits require user review in the SFL window before Apply.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_open_figure_module_pr
tools.title: Apply a reviewed Open Figure Modules pull request
tools.description: Re-check GitHub identity, module path collisions, optional similar-search confirmation, and file identities; then create a two-commit PR through the Git Data API. Never merges.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_publish
tools.title: Prepare one publication for human review
tools.description: Read-only proposal or exact Working preflight. Default local; propose readable bilingual titles and a scientific question. Show the preview and this complete plan once. No pre-confirmation booleans, Gallery writes, Library writes, GitHub writes or code execution.

application.description: FigureYa-style biological use cases as Markdown; required for new or updated Working revisions. Not visual encodings.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_publish
tools.title: Apply the single human-confirmed publication
tools.description: Only after the user approves the exact plan and the host completes its Gallery actions. Publish locally by default; an explicitly planned Open Module PR follows without another approval. Same operationId resumes completed stages; never merges or executes plotting code.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_publication_export
tools.title: Plan a sanitized public-template submission export
tools.description: Resolve one exact reachable Local Published Release and show every included/excluded asset, rights declaration, public metadata conflict, render trace, and target without writing files.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_publication_export
tools.title: Apply a confirmed sanitized publication export
tools.description: Revalidate the exact Local Published Release and selected asset bytes, then atomically create one deterministic sanitized submission at a new target. This call never uses the network, signs content, or creates a PR.

tools.name: figure_library_list_provider_sources
tools.title: List configured personal figure providers
tools.description: Read the configured personal provider sources and their last-known-good snapshot identities without making any network request. The raw trusted public key is never returned.

tools.name: figure_library_plan_provider_source_change
tools.title: Plan a signed personal provider change
tools.description: Plan Add, Update, Configure, Remove, or explicit Trust Reset for a signed personal provider. Network access occurs only when the requested action must verify a snapshot. Planning never writes configuration or snapshots.

expectedProviderId.description: Add only: independently expected providerId; the signed manifest and catalog must match it.

providerId.description: Existing providerId for Update, Configure, Remove, or Trust Reset.

manifestUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL for the canonical signed provider manifest.

publicKeyBase64.description: Add/Trust Reset: independently obtained canonical base64 for the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

includeInDefaultSearch.description: Opt in to ordinary default search. Add defaults this to false.

allowSequenceReset.description: Trust-reset only: explicitly permit a lower sequence under the new trust epoch.

autoRefresh.description: Official Open Figure Modules only: enable or disable signed-feed auto refresh.

tools.name: figure_library_apply_provider_source_change
tools.title: Apply a confirmed signed provider change
tools.description: Apply the exact cached provider-source plan with stale-state checks and operation-id replay protection. Apply never accepts a raw public key or endpoint override.

expectedProviderId.description: Provider-qualified identity declared by the signed personal catalog.

tools.name: figure_library_network_status
tools.description: Read this process's current user/machine proxy configuration; does not prove forwarding.

tools.name: figure_library_network_test
tools.description: Run a bounded connectivity test only against the fixed SFL GitHub releases endpoint.

tools.name: figure_library_update_status
tools.description: Report running/latest stable SFL versions, cache age and release link; refresh manually if requested.
